title: Conditional integer-profile envelope for the 8/9 compiler moment tails
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Prove a conditional integer-profile envelope at `C=330007/100000000`, `rho=1e−9`, `c=8,b=9,u=1/5,v=1024`. For every finite honest integer addition histogram A and actual target-loss subhistogram L, with `P=P0+A`, `T=T0−L`, the one strict mixed budget `A_t+(1−rho)L_t<R0<43` implies `alpha<1−rho`, `gamma,delta<.97`, and `alpha^1024+2gamma^1024+2delta^1024<1`.

All 240 H25 baseline targets remain hypothetical. R0<43 is an explicit conditional premise, not a newly recomputed price or an accepted future ledger. No new targets, paid deletions or signed netting are permitted. Separate A/L quotas do not replace the mixed inequality, and any later 8H1 charges spend 8 from the same allowance. The rank estimate `r<1849` supports a tail bound; it is not an ambient or physical geometry certificate. This positive scalar lemma supplies no funded κ or complete compiler/physical/ordinary/precision/stock/outer admission.

The PR also repairs the shared CI navigation document after the selected frontier promotion: its current section now points to [PR #5413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413)/[PR #5407](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5407)/[PR #5414](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5414) and `make frontier5413-verify`, while the [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610) section links its historical checkpoint. This documentation-only successor changes no scientific package bytes or tests.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment answers priority-revision 7 `independent-moment` with `scope_status: changed` for a positive robustness lemma. Canonical base is `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`; selected κ remains `.003027288235` under the same five assumptions. Peer precision approved this complementary publication and retains ownership of the extension. There is no overlapping planned robust-tail publication and no unreleased receiver or physical word in this package.

P0/T0 are retained from [public PR5418](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5418), exact `fe4c345778554ec5c02368b1ddf2f6918eeb0df5`, with a raw Git commit/tree/blob origin proof. That public side commit is not claimed as a canonical ancestor; the needed model bytes are self-contained. Peer lemma `c861887a57044497089b1861f2c6294a3e42409c48736c030776b7a8d7b7ec88` and root independent audit `2033e1d00fe41fbcdd15da84910296c3611a947c9175d8c4a0a12e3a44498d6c` are LOCAL credit references by hash only. Root owns publication, live overlap and hosted CI.

## Validation

The proof derives baseline bounds `(T0)_t>1024320/65` and `(P0)_(t+u)/8^u<301423/20` from finite binomial and integer-power comparisons. The mixed budget and integer multiplicity give `A_t<43`, `L_t<44`, `r<1849<8·3^5`, and added paid higher numerator below 129. Thus the remaining denominator exceeds 1021460/65 and

```
gamma <19760195/20429200<97/100,
delta <828360/1021460<97/100.
```

Their exact cross-product margins are 5612900 and 16245620. Bernoulli plus `(100/97)^32>2` and the exact reserve threshold `rho>1/1099511626752` close the full scalar envelope. The written proof quantifies all future A,L; finite certificate checks do not enumerate them or verify an actual future mixed budget.

The small verifier uses only integer/rational standard-library arithmetic, with no Powers, fractional-power evaluation, price point, native/receiver/compiler/primary engine or physical data. Nine meaningful domain/model controls reject fractional additions, negative netting, excessive losses, new targets, paid deletions, dropping the mixed hypothesis, ambient/earned-target overclaims and changed parameters. A=42H1,L=H4 is a valid integer-domain countercontrol: both loose separate quotas hold but its mixed consumption exceeds 43. Public-model byte and forged-origin mutations also reject. All normal/O predicates are explicit, source loading uses a private bytecode namespace and full pre/post custody is required.

Independent static review passed for the sealed 23-file snapshot and all 10 public origins. The sole peer completed exactly four integer-certificate executions: registered normal/O pair **1.410836020 seconds**, readonly temporary Git-free normal **0.302753654 seconds**, optimized **0.504951121 seconds**, each under 30 seconds/128 MiB with exit 0 and no resource stop. All four complete certificate JSONs are identical with **zero comparison exclusions**; their raw receipt hashes are also identical. Default sorted-JSON digest is `1c2bd9ecc56d6ff84808fdf7190e88885e121619ca920ad3676c132a8f47ec4d`. All 23 working files and 23 tested readonly temporary files remain unchanged; both direct modes used empty PATH, files 0444 and no `.git`. Raw child receipts/stdout/stderr, exact guard logs and pre/post inventories are preserved.

Only after these tests, the identical 23 source files were committed as `302c11c02b15be8a62c8da29784b1bb11737cf1c`, direct parent `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`. Current metadata, committed-byte/declared-source-history and official export/check pass. Official export SHA256 `60d1fab0d32a79c5b0a3323036d2367d08362cc6c4b97b9d3a854f8c81412f56`, 634,880 bytes, contains 23 source files plus its transport receipt. Every exported source byte matches the reviewed/requested/executed working and readonly temporary source. The final official 24-member export was byte-checked through this explicit bridge and **was not separately rerun**. During local assembly there was no pricing/Powers, physical, primary or additional integer-verifier execution; the subsequent hosted replay is reported separately below.

Hosted CI at original head `302c11c02b15be8a62c8da29784b1bb11737cf1c` failed in shared onboarding test `CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` before package selection or replay. The CI guide still named `make frontier4610-verify` while the selected record required `make frontier5413-verify`. The unchanged six-test navigation module reproduced that failure before the documentation repair and passed all six afterward. The current publication head is `baa8fbb8345c2fab0bc213479539c338d4c80443`, whose sole delta from the tested scientific commit is `docs/ci-verification.md`. All 23 mathematical package blobs remain exactly identical. No tests or workflow checks were disabled, and no extra local scientific replay was run. [Hosted run 40062451036](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40062451036) subsequently passed at this exact successor head: shared onboarding/selection and registered package replay, including committed-inputs-unchanged. The earlier failed run remains preserved as evidence. These hosted executions are separate from the four local certificate runs above, and do not execute the later written analytical addendum or establish physical or kappa admission.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa0033-robust-tail-envelope
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/kappa0033-robust-tail-envelope --check-source-history
```

Direct Git-free command: `/usr/bin/python3 -I -B research/kappa0033-robust-tail-envelope/verify.py`; add `-O` or use `--integrity-only` to authenticate without running the integer verifier. No third-party dependencies. Source/history/export checks establish declared provenance and transport, not complete local canonical history, human/kernel proof or hosted-CI equivalence.

## Open next questions

A [separate self-contained written addendum](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5420#issuecomment-6379904439) derives total gross added rank mass at most 43 and the aggregate-target-moment-loss extension under its stated count and budget hypotheses. It was independently reviewed as written mathematics, is outside this sealed verifier, and claims no new execution, actual caller funding or private construction.

A future actual receiver must bind its complete honest gross A,L account and prove the one strict mixed inequality, with all extra H1 calls and target losses included. Canonical independent outputs, arbitrary owned/restoration columns, ambient/adapters, ordinary movement/cost, precision/error/semantic constants, stock/tape, chronological splitting/completion and full compiler/outer application remain separate obligations. The lemma removes repeated scalar tail checks only within its exact hypotheses. A changed target profile that increases some rank multiplicities, including a rank-downgrade replacement, requires an explicit transfer argument outside this stated subhistogram theorem; no such transfer is claimed here. The goal of achieved conditional κ≥.0033 remains open; `TASK.json` records relevance, first steps and blockers.
